item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01030","case1_error":"Miscomputes the correctly written calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975, propagating the error to remaining calories.","case2_error":"Miscomputes the correctly written sum 8 + 12 + 16 + 4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate a correctly written sum.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01031","case1_error":"Equates the remaining two patients' sessions with 25 − 6, omitting the second patient's sessions, then doubles the supposed combined remainder.","case2_error":"Miscomputes 8 + 12 + 16 + 4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"Case 1 introduces incorrect relations and double-counts a combined quantity; case 2 numerically miscalculates a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01032","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 120/2 by dividing again to obtain 30, then asserts 15 without supporting calculation.","case2_error":"Treats 50 required hours as a trip count, substitutes 1000 minutes for daily driving, and divides incompatible units.","reason":"Case 1 corrupts evaluation of a correct average formula and gives an unsupported final value; case 2 constructs incorrect quantities and unit relations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01033","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan's quarter-share, omitting Chris's removal.","case2_error":"Evaluates 12 + 4 + 12 + 24 + 1 as 55 instead of 53, and drops the 10 pending decorations.","reason":"Both omit a required contribution, but case 2 additionally miscalculates an explicit sum, so their observable error mechanisms do not fully match.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01034","case1_error":"The leading and final answers say 20, conflicting with the correct derivation of 12 per chair.","case2_error":"Omits the additional 20% bulk discount, reporting savings of 75 instead of 120.","reason":"Case 1 has an answer conflict with an otherwise correct derivation, requiring uncertain; case 2 clearly omits a discount.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
